# Support Policy

This project is for **personal research purposes**, and as such, **no support, questions, or inquiries will be answered**.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q. Can I ask questions in Issues or Pull Requests?**  
A. **No, questions are not accepted.** Any issues containing questions may be closed without response.

**Q. Can I report a bug?**  
A. Bug reports are welcome, but there is no guarantee of a fix. If you find a problem, you are encouraged to fork the repository and resolve it on your own.

## Contributions

- Feature requests or bug reports may be submitted via Issues, but there is no guarantee of any response or action.
- Pull Requests are welcome, but their review and acceptance are **not guaranteed**.
- Please do not use Issues or Pull Requests as a place for general discussion or questions.
